description: LATE BOX ARRIVALS 1 - REACH. match::ai::ActionSelectorSecondLineSpaceRun, params builder 0x143e025d0 (called only from this selector's vf4 0x143dfec50 and vf6 0x143dfc670). Widens the three geometric gates that decide WHICH midfielder may start a second-line run: max straight-line distance from the ball 25->40 m, max lateral offset from the ball 20->30 m, and how far behind the ball he may be 12->20 m. Only the STRICT (first-contact) set is widened; the permissive hysteresis set (17/30/30) is untouched. Three RIP-relative disp32 re-aims onto existing read-only pool cells; no cell is edited, no instruction changes length. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/latebox-reach.json
